About

A Brazilian artist
observing Ireland

Tiago Barcelos is a Brazilian visual artist based in Dublin. He arrived in Ireland as many do, navigating an unfamiliar city while working as a delivery rider. That experience became the foundation of his practice: the streets, the people, the invisible labour that keeps a city moving.

His work unfolds through observation of everyday life, where themes of presence, displacement and belonging quietly emerge. Through oil on canvas, he finds the quiet weight in what often goes unnoticed.

Between these two realities, Brazil and Ireland, he finds a language that is entirely his own.
